bio.text: Rick Cheatum represents Idaho House District 28, Seat A, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which lists Pocatello as the legislator's city.
The directory biography says Cheatum was born in western Kansas, moved to Idaho in 1977, and holds a B.S. in broadcast journalism from the University of Kansas.
It says Cheatum retired in 2017, was elected to the Pocatello City Council that year and re-elected in 2021, and served as Council President in 2022 and 2023.
